name: Extend
description: Extend lets agents look up virtual cards, card transactions, and receipts in the signed-in Extend account. Each user signs in to their own Extend account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which virtual cards had the most spend this month?
List the transactions from last week that have no receipt.
Summarize the limits and remaining balance of my active virtual cards.

apps.name: Extend
apps.description: Virtual card, transaction, and receipt lookups, over Extend's MCP server with browser sign-in.
